captions.detailed: This 3D model is a wedge-shaped door stop or wedge widget with an L-shaped layout. It consists of a long, tapered arm that acts as the main wedge, and a shorter, thicker rectangular block extending perpendicular to it at the head. The outer curved corner of the L-junction is rounded, while one face features a grid of small hemispherical bumps for grip, and the long sloped face has a series of vertical cylindrical ribs running down its side.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric door wedge with an L-shaped profile. The script should allow the user to adjust the overall width, thickness, height, and step size of the grip features, incorporating a series of ribbed cylinders along one edge and a matrix of grip bumps on the front face.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a custom module 'theL' which joins a central cylinder at the corner with two intersecting cubes (the long side and the short side). A for-loop places a series of small cylinders along the outer edge to create a ribbed grip texture, while another nested structure places a grid of spheres on the front face for additional grip. Finally, a difference operation uses a large subtractive cube to cut the assembled L-shape at an angle, creating the wedge's sloped ramp profile.
